findings.source_quote: His primary goal with his studies was to become a physician, instead, by the providence of God, he became a minister of the gospel of Jesus Christ.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the vocation phrase accurately and consistently. Replace the translation segment that reads “alihitimu kuwa kwa misionari wa injili ya Yesu Kristo” with a clear Swahili rendering preserving the original meaning (minister of the gospel), for example: “lengo lake kuu kwa masomo yake lilikuwa kuwa daktari; badala yake, kwa mashauri ya Mungu, aligeuka kuwa mchungaji wa injili ya Yesu Kristo.” Preserve HTML and surrounding sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: Lengo lake kuu kwa masomo yake lilikuwa kuwa daktari; badala yake, kwa juu ya miujiza ya Mungu, alihitimu kuwa kwa misionari wa injili ya Yesu Kristo.

findings.source_quote: “To their mutual grief, they found themselves [both] groping for the light, veritable blind guides”.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the original metaphorical sense: they discovered themselves groping for light, like true blind guides. Replace the translation ““Kwa masikitiko yao pamoja, walikutana wakiwa [wote wawili] wakifuatilia mwanga, viongozi wa kweli wakiwa wagonjwa.”” with a faithful rendering such as: “’Kwa masikitiko yao pamoja, walijikuta [wote wawili] wakitafuna mwanga, kana kwamba walikuwa waongoza vipofu.’” Keep punctuation and quotation marks as in source HTML.
findings.translation_quote: “Kwa masikitiko yao pamoja, walikutana wakiwa [wote wawili] wakifuatilia mwanga, viongozi wa kweli wakiwa wagonjwa.”

findings.location: source.html — paragraph after poem (sentence about whom he gave the hymn)
findings.source_quote: This hymn he gave to one of the family members that very night.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the identity from “wanajamii” (community members) to “mwanachama wa familia / mmoja wa wanafamilia” to match the English. For example: replace “Wimbo huu aliutoa kwa mmoja wa wanajamii usiku huo wenyewe.” with “Wimbo huu aliwapa mmoja wa wanafamilia usiku huo.” Preserve surrounding HTML tags and sentence placement.
findings.translation_quote: Wimbo huu aliutoa kwa mmoja wa wanajamii usiku huo mwenyewe.
